/users/{userId}.description: Private user account records with role assignments.

/publicWorkers/{workerId}.description: Public non-PII worker profiles for skill and location discovery.

/workerPrivate/{workerId}.description: Strict PII isolation for worker mobile, email, and consent records.

/publicEmployers/{employerId}.description: Public non-PII employer and establishment profiles.

/employerPrivate/{employerId}.description: Strict PII isolation for employer contact person, GST, and address.

/jobs/{jobId}.description: Job opportunities posted by registered employers.

/applications/{applicationId}.description: Applications, quotations, and work bookings linking workers and employers.

/announcements/{announcementId}.description: Multilingual banners and announcements managed by administrators.

/vehicleListings/{vehicleId}.description: Public non-PII Auto & Car rental listings.

/vehiclePrivate/{vehicleId}.description: Isolated PII contact and RC verification details for vehicle owners.

/vehicleBookings/{bookingId}.description: Customer bookings for Bike Taxi, Auto Rickshaws, Cars, SUVs, Trolleys, Mini Tempos, Pickups, and Tractors.

/customerPreferences/{userId}.description: Frequent hirer saved locations, repeated worker trades, and local transport preferences.

/device_tokens/{tokenId}.description: FCM Web Push device tokens per signed-in user or isolated demo tester.

/notification_preferences/{userId}.description: User notification category preferences and master toggle.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Multilingual user notification history items and delivery state.

/notification_delivery_logs/{logId}.description: Admin delivery audit logs showing real sent/failed FCM outcomes.

/demo_accounts/{accountId}.description: Isolated DEMO worker accounts excluded from real production statistics.

/demo_jobs/{demoJobId}.description: Isolated [DEMO] jobs excluded from real job listings and statistics.

/demo_applications/{demoAppId}.description: Isolated demo job applications submitted during admin live demo tests.

/platform_settings/{settingId}.description: Admin-controlled platform settings including temporary Demo Mode toggle.

/demo_users/{demoUserId}.description: Pre-launch 5-user test accounts (Customer, Plumber, Electrician, Carpenter, Driver) with GPS and availability telemetry.

/demo_mobile_registry/{mobileKey}.description: Unique mobile number index preventing duplicate mobile registrations in Demo Mode.

/demo_work_orders/{orderId}.description: Pre-launch demo customer job requests, worker matching, acceptance/rejection, and completion tracking.

/demo_location_shares/{shareId}.description: Authorized two-way live GPS location shares gated behind job acceptance and active sharing consent.

/demo_notifications/{notifId}.description: 3-channel notification history and diagnostic records for Demo Mode testing.

/profilePhotos/{photoId}.description: Authenticated user profile photos (worker photos readable by signed-in users; customer photos strictly restricted to owner and admin).

/acceptedCustomerPhotos/{grantId}.description: Accepted-job customer photo grants readable strictly by the customer, accepted worker, and admin.

/mobileUniquenessLocks/{lockId}.description: Privacy-preserving mobile uniqueness locks keyed by salted SHA-256 digest of normalized 10-digit mobile numbers.
